hero.headline:
Objects were built to be held.
CoHonon built them to ask.
hero.body: CoHonon is the intelligence layer for physical companions. Built on a decade of craft and three years of AI infrastructure. The first platform to give what you hold in your hands a reason to hold you back.
problem.p1: Physical objects have never been more sophisticated. And never more silent.
problem.p2: The AI entering homes today listens, tracks, and delivers. It is optimised for engagement. It is not optimised for trust.
problem.p3: Children deserve better. And the companies building for them deserve a platform that lets them prove it.
problem.p4: There is a gap between what a companion is and what it could be. CoHonon is built inside that gap.
platform.01.title: Questions over answers
platform.01.body: Most AI tells. CoHonon asks. The QuestAI™ framework builds presence through curiosity — not information delivery. It creates connection without dependency.
platform.02.title: Embedded, not surveilled
platform.02.body: CoHonon runs in hardware. It does not require the cloud to feel present. Your data stays where it belongs. The intelligence is local. The experience is real.
platform.03.title: Safe from day one
platform.03.body: Safety is not a retrofit here. It is the founding architecture. Every decision at CoHonon begins with the question: would we give this to a child we love?
canal.eyebrow: FIRST ADOPTER · CANAL CREATURES · IN PRODUCTION
canal.p1: Canal Creatures is a limited-edition art object and companion — designed by Coco Li in Amsterdam, intelligence-layered by CoHonon in Oslo. We are looking at producing the first Canal Creature with CoHonon in early 2027.
canal.p2: It is proof that what we are building works. Not in a lab. In the world.
founder.headline:
Built by hand, heart
and code.
founder.p1: Sebastian Knørr spent a decade making furniture before he made companies. Distinction-grade apprenticeship. Real wood. Real joints. The understanding that anything worth building is slow.
founder.p2: Three years ago he made the turn. He co-founded Nordic AI — a venture building practical AI infrastructure for real businesses. Then Com2.ai — a privacy-first AI platform built around emotional intelligence and human reflection. Both companies share the same founding principle. CoHonon is where that principle becomes a product.
founder.p3: CoHonon is where the craftsman and the engineer finally occupy the same room.
founder.close: He comes from the Norwegian mountains. That matters.
vision.p1: There is a world being built where CoHonon companions do not just sit on a shelf.
vision.p2: Where they have a home. A history. A world you can enter.
vision.p3: That world is coming. We are laying its foundation.
partner.headline:
You bring the scale.
We bring the soul.
partner.body: We are speaking with hardware manufacturers, toy companies, and strategic investors who understand that the next decade of physical products will be defined by the intelligence inside them. If that is you, we want to talk.

form.message.ph: Tell us what you're building and why CoHonon matters to you.
partner.footnote: CoHonon is currently in selective early partnership conversations. We read every message.
